title: Four Books
note: คลิปวิดีโอเจนมาแล้วจากที่อื่น ไม่ผ่าน gen-video-evolink.mjs — วางไว้ที่ output/four-books/clips/ ตรงๆ (ชื่อไฟล์ต้นฉบับชัดเจนไม่กำกวม: SCENE 1 — THE HOOK / BOOK N.M / THE FINAL CHOICE)

scenes.narration: You find four books inside a room that shouldn't exist. Each book contains a secret no human was meant to know. One reveals the future. One reveals every secret. One can rewrite the past. And one… can rewrite reality itself. Which book would you open?
scenes.sfx_prompt: low mystical drone, faint page rustling

scenes.narration: Book One: The Book of Tomorrow. Every page shows something that hasn't happened yet.
scenes.sfx_prompt: golden magical hum, faint page turning

scenes.narration: You read about tomorrow's lottery numbers. Tomorrow's disasters. Even the exact moment someone will betray you. You become impossible to surprise.
scenes.sfx_prompt: shimmering golden chime, rapid page flipping

scenes.narration: But one page always remains blank. Your own future. Until one night… it finally writes something. "Tomorrow, you will stop reading."
Book Two: The Book of Truth. Read one page… and every lie becomes visible.
You discover who is lying to you. Who secretly hates you. Who betrayed you. Soon, there is nothing anyone can hide from you.
scenes.sfx_prompt: overlapping whisper chorus, subtle psychic chime

scenes.narration: Then you open a page about yourself. And discover the worst secret of all. You were never supposed to be here.
Book Three: The Book of Yesterday. This one gives you something even more dangerous. A second chance.
You rewrite your biggest mistake. The person you lost comes back. The accident never happens. Your entire life becomes perfect.
scenes.sfx_prompt: warm nostalgic swell, soft temporal chime

scenes.narration: But changing one moment changes everything after it. You return to the present… and nobody remembers you.
Book Four: The Book of Creation. This book has only one rule. Whatever you write becomes real.
scenes.sfx_prompt: deep ominous heartbeat pulse, cold black energy hiss

scenes.narration: You write for money. It appears. You write for power. You receive it. You write one final sentence: "I will never die."
scenes.sfx_prompt: quill scratching intensely, rising ominous hum

scenes.narration: The moment you finish the sentence… another sentence appears underneath it. "You will never die." "Because I need you to keep writing."
scenes.sfx_prompt: deep pulsing heartbeat drone, faint quill scratching on its own

scenes.narration: One book lets you see tomorrow. One lets you know every secret. One lets you rewrite yesterday. And one lets you rewrite reality. But there is a reason these books were hidden. Some knowledge is better left unread. So… Which book would you open?
scenes.sfx_prompt: layered ominous drone, heavy page rustling
